back.description: One quiet line that leads back to the parent page: a left arrow, the muted label "Back to", and the page name as the link.

prev.description: A card for the previous page: an optional still, then the label "Previous" with a left chevron, and the page name as the link. In a card narrower than 34rem the still sits on top. The whole card is the link.

attributes.name: img
attributes.description: A still shown in the card, as a path relative to the note. Decorative, so it has no alt text. Left out, the card is text only.

next.description: A card for the next page: an optional still, then the label "Next" with a right chevron, the page name as the link, and an optional muted preview line. In a card narrower than 34rem the still sits on top and the text is right-aligned. The whole card is the link.

attributes.name: img
attributes.description: A still shown on the left half of the card, as a path relative to the note. Decorative, so it has no alt text. Left out, the card is text only.

links.description: A row of link chips, such as Repository and Demo, from the Markdown list of links inside it. Each chip is one link at least 44px tall, and the row wraps.
